physicalNotes: Radius 1.26 +0.06/-0.08 Jupiter radii: the Bayesian model average of the GRAVITY and archival-spectrum retrievals of Nasedkin et al. (2024, A&A 687, A298; arXiv:2404.03776), Table 3, constrained by the dynamical mass of Zurlo et al. (2022) as a prior: 90,079.9 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. A model radius fitted to the spectrum, not a measured diameter: the planet is unresolved. GM from the dynamical mass 9.19 Jupiter masses of Zurlo et al. (2022, A&A 666, A133, Table 3 model 1) times Jupiter's GM 126686531.9 km^3/s^2. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

prediction.reference: whereistheplanet (Wang et al. 2021) distributes a GRAVITY orbit fit for the four planets, not yet published; it is what Sallum et al. (2026, arXiv:2609.10507) predict these planets with.
